Agent response: Oh no, I understand how frustrating it can be to not have tracking information for your order! Here's how you can usually track your order: If you're a registered user: Log in to your account. On your profile, select "Order History". Click the tracking link under the order you're looking for. If you placed your order as a guest: You can often find your tracking number in the order confirmation email we sent you. Alternatively, for customers shopping from the United States, you can: Visit our Order Tracking page. Enter your email address or zip code. Enter your Order # or Tracking #. Click "Track Your Order" to see your shipping status. Please note that the guest tracking process might vary slightly depending on your region (e.g., Europe, Australia, Canada, UK might primarily use the tracking link from the shipping confirmation email).
